svg.title: RareOcto final tech stack architecture
svg.desc: Complete architecture: Next.js frontend, Supabase backend, Razorpay payments, Cloudinary media, Vercel hosting

g.text: Backend layer — Supabase (one platform, four jobs)
Try-on layer — runs in browser, zero server cost
Built into the same Next.js app at /admin route, protected by Supabase auth role.
Friend logs in, manages catalog (add/edit/delete designs), views orders, updates inventory.
Uses shadcn data tables. No separate platform needed.
